summary: The biggest clubs in the world, by Deloitte's 2026 Money League: Real Madrid, Barcelona and the English giants are gimmes, and Juventus (#16) and AC Milan (#15) are the traps. It leans easy.
reasons: Builder's own replay, pending a real judge. A casual who barely follows soccer finds Real Madrid, Barcelona, the Manchester clubs, Liverpool, Chelsea, Arsenal and Bayern, and loses lives on Juventus and AC Milan, each with its revenue; a soccer fan sweeps it.

Short forms work (barca, man utd, psg, spurs, bayern, juve, inter); 'manchester' offers both clubs. Every club from 29 earlier seasons is an answer with its last rank ('Ajax: #27 in 2021–22'); Inter Miami, LA Galaxy, Al Hilal and Boca Juniors are free.
32 clubs carry this season's revenue: a casual Blitz scored 21 of 30.
